detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Oaken Tower is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where your tower of items fights other players. Build deadly combos and scale exponentially. Every decision matters.

Buy and combine powerful items, unlock game-changings perks and level up to discover rarer items, and build the ultimate tower.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Asynchronous roguelike PvP

  • Over 120+ unique items with class specific types

  • Gameplay progression through unlockable perks and cosmetic items

  • 20+ game-changing NPC encounters

  • Deeply synergistic item system with exponential combo potential

  • Casual and Ranked gameplay modes with leaderboards and seasons

  • Endless Mode

CHASE THE PERFECT COMBO

Discover synergies between items that don't just add up; they multiply! The right combination of items and unlockable perks can create exponential scaling, enabling you to build unstoppable loadouts.

CASUAL AND RANKED MODES

Jump into casual mode for a pressure-free experience or rise to the challenge of competitive ranked play and see how your build stacks up against the best towers.
